    The platform that powers your video strategy

    • Host in high quality, ad‑free

      Host in high quality, ad‑free

      Ensure your videos play in their highest resolution, always ad‑free. No competitor distractions or random suggestions here.

      Learn about video hosting

    • Collaborate with anyone

      Learn about video collaboration

      Learn about video player

      Keep your content secure with granular access management and advanced privacy settings like password protection.

      Learn about video security

    • Sell your content

      Sell your content

      Monetize content on demand and even build a subscription platform with simple tools that adjust to your business model.

      Learn about video monetization

    • Stream live with confidence

      Stream live with confidence

      Host virtual events, webinars, live broadcasts, and more with Vimeo’s suite of easy-to-use live streaming tools.

      Learn about live streaming

    A video solution perfect for everyone

    Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, Vimeo’s intuitive platform makes it easy to upload, manage, and share your videos with complete control over privacy and distribution.

    See our plans

    • Video pros →

      Showcase work, collaborate with clients, and connect with a passionate community of filmmakers and creatives.

    • Marketing teams →

      Elevate your brand with high-quality video and expand your reach with precision and control.

    • Communications teams →

      Centralize communication and maximize engagement with high‑quality, live events, and secure video hosting.

    • Learning and development leaders →

      Scale training with interactive, AI‑powered videos that integrate with any LMS to engage global teams in various languages.

    • Content businesses →

      Monetize your videos with everything you need to grow and manage your audience.

    • Enterprise organizations →

      Streamline video workflows across your company with customizable solutions that scale with business needs.

    What customers are saying

    AI that takes your videos to the next level

    Save time and money on localization with AI-powered video translation. Adapt your videos into dozens of languages, both audio and captions, in minutes.

    Translate with AI

    Within the video player, viewers can ask questions and get answers that link to the specific moment of the video for helpful context.

    Find answers with AI

    Edit your video’s transcript to trim, cut, and rearrange footage. Plus, the timeline editor is always there when you need it.

    Edit video by text

    Vimeo AI provides SEO-optimized titles, descriptions, chapters, and tags. Just upload, click to generate, and share away.

    Answers to common video privacy questions

    • Go to the Help Center

    You can set privacy controls when uploading or anytime after by editing your video settings.

    Vimeo offers five privacy levels:

    • Public (all plans): Discoverable by anyone, appears in search engines
    • Unlisted (paid plans): Accessible only via direct URL with privacy hash
    • Password (paid plans): Requires password entry to view
    • Hide from Vimeo (paid plans): Can be embedded but has no Vimeo page
    • Private (all plans): Visible only to you, account admins, and granted team members

    Simply choose your desired privacy level in your video settings. Changes take effect instantly across all devices and platforms.

    Instantly. Permissions update in real-time across all devices and platforms. When you change a video’s privacy settings or remove team member access, the changes are immediate — no waiting periods or delays.

    Yes, Vimeo provides detailed analytics for all privacy levels. You can see viewer statistics, engagement metrics, and access patterns. Enterprise accounts get additional analytics features for internal content sharing.

    Most advanced privacy features require paid plans.

    Free plans include Public and Private settings.

    Paid plans (Starter, Standard, Advanced) include Unlisted, Password protection, Hide from Vimeo, plus embed domain-level privacy controls.

    Enterprise plans add custom permissions, SSO integration (SAML/SCIM), and advanced team management.

    While Vimeo doesn’t offer automatic time-expiring links, you can manually control access duration by:

    • Using Unlisted videos with privacy hash URLs that you can change by updating privacy settings
    • Setting up password-protected videos and changing passwords when access should expire
    • Adding/removing team members from Private videos as needed
    • Using the “Hide from Vimeo” setting to control when embedded videos are accessible

    For more granular time-based controls, Enterprise accounts offer custom permissions that can be managed through your admin dashboard.

    Download protection varies by privacy setting:

    • Private videos: Cannot be embedded anywhere, providing the strongest download protection
    • Password/Unlisted videos: Have basic download prevention, but determined users with technical knowledge may still access content

    For maximum security, use Private settings combined with team member access controls. Enterprise accounts receive additional forensic tracking capabilities to monitor unauthorized access attempts.

    Team collaboration with Private videos works through Vimeo’s team member system:

    • Private videos are visible to the owner, account admins, and any team members granted access to the video or its folder
    • Team member access is not supported on Free, Basic, or Plus plans
    • Paid plans allow you to add team members and control their access to specific videos or folders
    • Enterprise accounts with SSO can authenticate team members automatically for internal sharing

    You can grant access at the individual video level or organize content in folders with team-specific permissions.

#e5e5e5;margin-top:32px;padding-top:16px"><h2>Have questions?</h2><dl style="margin:0"><div style="margin-bottom:16px"><dt style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">What's different about hosting videos on Vimeo?</dt><dd style="margin:0">Videos hosted on Vimeo can stream up to 4K Ultra HD so your viewers see your videos in the highest quality and unlike other platforms, we never put ads before, during, or after your videos - even on our Free plan.</dd></div><div style="margin-bottom:16px"><dt style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">Will viewers see third-party ads on my videos?</dt><dd style="margin:0">Absolutely not. Your work will never be tarnished by in-video ads. That’s right — no pre-roll, post-roll, or overlays. On Vimeo, you can present your work in exactly the way you want.</dd></div><div style="margin-bottom:16px"><dt style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">Can I cancel anytime?</dt><dd style="margin:0">Yes, all our plans are risk-free. You’ll get a full refund if you decide to cancel anytime within the first 14 days of an annual subscription, or within the first 3 days of a monthly subscription. If you no longer need the added benefits of your current plan, you can downgrade to another plan.</dd></div><div style="margin-bottom:16px"><dt style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">What are AI credits?</dt><dd style="margin:0">AI credits are a flexible way to purchase AI translation features as needed. See <u><a href="/help/sso?redirect_to=https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.vimeo.com%2Fhc%2Fen-us%2Farticles%2F33610803164177">this help center article</a></u> for more information.</dd></div><div style="margin-bottom:16px"><dt style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">How do I buy AI credits?</dt><dd style="margin:0">In the video settings page, you can access AI translations either by selecting Languages from the left side panel or going through the AI icon on the bottom right. After you go through the flow to translate the subtitles of your video, you will be prompted to purchase the relevant amount of credits for that translation. All Vimeo plans come with the ability to try AI features for free.</dd></div><div style="margin-bottom:16px"><dt style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">Is there a video limit?</dt><dd style="margin:0">There are no limitations on the number of videos you can create, upload, and host in your account. Users are only limited on how much they can upload based on storage, measured in gigabytes (GB).</dd></div><div style="margin-bottom:16px"><dt style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">What happens if I go over my storage limit?</dt><dd style="margin:0">Should you hit your storage limit, you can upgrade your plan. Members of these plans get tons more storage, in addition to advanced customization and powerful marketing and analytics tools, than Free members.</dd></div><div style="margin-bottom:16px"><dt style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">Do team members share the storage limit?</dt><dd style="margin:0">Yes. Your plan includes an allowance for uploading and creating videos that are shared with all your team members. The storage allowance is at your account level which allows paid users on your account to upload or create videos up to the account limit.</dd></div><div style="margin-bottom:16px"><dt style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">Is the Free plan just a free trial?</dt><dd style="margin:0">Nope. The Free plan is perfect for individuals who want to join our amazing community, but who might not be uploading tons of videos each week. If that sounds like you, you might never pay a dime for Vimeo. Businesses and Creators often upgrade their plan because they find they want to store more videos, customize their player, have more privacy options, or access more marketing tools.</dd></div><div style="margin-bottom:16px"><dt style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">Do you have duration or file-size restrictions?</dt><dd style="margin:0">There is a size limit of 300GB gigabytes and a duration limit of 24 Hours per video file, regardless of plan.</dd></div><div style="margin-bottom:16px"><dt style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">Can I stream live events with Vimeo?</dt><dd style="margin:0">Yes! In order to live stream, you’ll need an Advanced or Enterprise plan. Our live streaming product was built as a high-quality solution for professionals and includes a whole suite of live streaming tools for your events. In addition to live streaming features, the Advanced plan includes all the video hosting and marketing features you need to power your workflow from video and event creation, to team collaboration, to customer engagement, to analytics, and beyond.</dd></div><div style="margin-bottom:16px"><dt style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">Do Vimeo's self-serve plans have a bandwidth limit?</dt><dd style="margin:0">Bandwidth is the data used in order to deliver your videos to viewers. We’ve set the bandwidth limit on our self-serve accounts to 2 TB (2,000 GB) per month. We’ve set the limit so that 99% of our users will never reach it. You can always track your bandwidth usage within your account, and if you do end up reaching that monthly limit you will receive notifications asking you to lower your bandwidth consumption or discuss a more suitable plan with our sales team.     Video solutions and use cases

    • Vimeo for enterprise

      Bring your team together and take your business to brave new heights with our suite of simple, effective video tools.

    • Video for small business

      Get tools to help build your brand through video. We're talking production, streaming, sharing, and sales.

    • Video for creatives

      From creation and editing to hosting and marketing, this is the video platform built to support creative professionals.

    • Share knowledge with video

      Expand your reach beyond the classroom. Vimeo has the tools you need to connect with your community wherever they are.

    • Video marketing

      From creating and editing to collaboration and analytics, if you want to take your video marketing to the next level, you're in the right spot.

    • Seamlessly host virtual events

      The Vimeo video platform allows brands and marketers to create live streaming events and on-demand webinars. Gain viewers and leads with interactive tools.

    • Employee communications

      Inform and inspire your teams with engaging video content for trainings, virtual events, onboarding, panels, and more.

    • Monetize content

      Subscriptions, branded apps, and live events make it possible to make money with your videos.

    • Learning and development

      Create transformative L&D video experiences that empower employees with fresh skills and knowledge, while you harness data-driven insights.

    • Healthcare

      Vimeo helps you educate patients, connect with your team, and promote your organization — all while following best practices for privacy and confidentiality.

    • Retail

      Trusted by leading retail and ecommerce brands, Vimeo’s end-to-end platform helps you create, manage, and share content that delights customers and engages employees with dynamic product info and training.

    • Technology

      Vimeo is a reliable video platform for tech, SaaS, and other software companies — from engaging customers, to employee communications and training.

    • Financial services

      Trusted by banks and financial institutions to streamline company trainings, enhance client communications, and deliver engaging financial education videos to customers—all in one secure platform.

    • Vimeo Streaming

      Launch your own video streaming platform, monetize content, and reach global audiences across devices – from Apple TV to Roku.

    • Vimeo Central

      Our AI-powered, searchable video library makes it easy to share knowledge across internal teams and boost collaborative engagement in your employees.

    Video simplified for all

    Vimeo is on a mission to simplify what it takes to make, manage, and share video—all in a single, easy-to-use platform.

    The evolution of Vimeo

    Vimeo has grown from a place where creatives show off their work to a platform to create, edit, and share videos. It's for beginners and pros; it's for marketers and CEOs. Though our tools have evolved, our goal to help people create and share stunning videos hasn't changed.
